title: P1 — POST /v1/cancel returns 200 for unknown sessions, violating the OpenAPI contract: h3-protocol.yaml defines '404 SessionNotFound' for /v1/cancel (L133-134) and SESSION_NOT_FOUND = 'Session ID doesn't exist' 404 (L295-297); GET/DELETE /v1/sessions/{id} implement the 404 correctly. Dogfood-verified live 2026-08-08: curl POST /v1/cancel {session_id:'ghost'} -> 200 {"cancelled":true,"cancelled_decision_id":""} (false ack; a client cancelling a stale session thinks an in-flight decision was interrupted). Related asymmetry: POST /v1/result with an unknown session also executes (200 + decision) instead of 404 — no 404 is defined for /v1/result in the spec, so align with the spec and cancel's behavior. Fix: session-existence check in cancelHandler (and decide+document resultHandler policy). Pass criteria: POST /v1/cancel unknown session -> 404 {"error":{"code":"SESSION_NOT_FOUND"}}; known session still 200 {"cancelled":true}.
reasoning: Dogfood run 2026-08-08 (real-use): probed all error paths; cancel-on-unknown-session 200 vs OpenAPI 404. Contract mismatch confirmed against h3-protocol.yaml.
foreman_note: Tick #111: GAP-DOG-002 complete. cancel/result 404 SESSION_NOT_FOUND on unknown sessions. Commit addb017, guard 4/4, judge 4/4. Battery 44/44 (updated process-first 5_9 + new 5_9b, shim a3d3e54).

title: P2 — Session status never transitions to 'completed': GET /v1/sessions/{id} reports "status":"active" even after the harness returned an end decision, so a Hermes-side observer cannot tell a finished session from a live one. OpenAPI GET /v1/sessions/{session_id} describes the response as 'metadata for an active or completed session' (h3-protocol.yaml L141) and protocol.SessionStatus defines SessionCompleted (types.go:275) — but harness.go sessionStore only ever sets 'active' (create) / 'cancelled' (cancel+delete). Dogfood-verified live 2026-08-08: full tool_call->text->end loop, then GET session -> status 'active' (turn_count 3). Distinct from GAP-009 (current_decision/current_decision_type never populated; cancelled_decision_id always "") — this is the lifecycle half of session observability. Fix: processHandler/resultHandler set status=SessionCompleted when the returned decision.Decision == DecisionEnd. Pass criteria: process -> end decision -> GET session -> status 'completed'.
reasoning: Dogfood run 2026-08-08 (real-use): after a complete agent loop the session still reads 'active'; OpenAPI promises 'active or completed'.
